reviewDecisions.rationale: Supply tightening and commodity rerating are real; the key research question is whether listed-company earnings room remains after the price move.
Official data show strong export/NEV growth; deep research must distinguish profitable scale from price-war volume.
Two independent Reuters observations support a real domestic semiconductor capability step; company-level earnings mapping remains required.
Production cuts and narrowing DRAM declines are real, but NAND oversupply and inventory make this a strict turning-point test.
Broad PMI/PPI recovery is useful timing context but not a narrow stock thesis.
